headline: Lasa Supergenerics submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Lasa Supergenerics
summary: Lasa Supergenerics Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing provides formal confirmation of shareholder voting outcomes at the meeting. This is a routine corporate governance filing for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding this stock should note the completion of the annual voting process.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate update with no immediate financial impact.
